file_insights.changes_summary: Added support for Garmin Connect disconnection workflow
key_modifications: Added pending_garmin_disconnect field to RustRideApp struct
Updated update method to poll disconnect task
Added disconnect handling in GarminSettingsAction match arm

patterns_discovered: Async task polling pattern for background operations
Consistent error handling and logging for OAuth/sync platform interactions
Using Arc<DefaultOAuthHandler> for thread-safe OAuth operations
State machine approach for connection states (Disconnecting, Disconnected, Error)
gotchas_discovered: Potential race conditions in async task completion handling
Need for comprehensive error handling in background tasks
Importance of non-blocking task checking and instant blocking when needed

approach_outcome.description: Implemented Garmin Connect disconnection workflow with async task support
key_achievements: Added support for revoking Garmin Connect authorization
Implemented UI state updates during disconnection process
Created robust error handling for disconnection scenarios

recommendations: Add unit tests for disconnect workflow
Consider adding timeout mechanism for disconnect operations
Implement more granular error types for sync platform interactions
Add telemetry or user-facing error messages for disconnect failures
